rules.meaning: Model license missing or unknown (empty, unknown/unbekannt/неизвестно, n/a, NOASSERTION, TBD).
Dataset license missing or unknown (same words).
Model version missing.
Model version floating: latest/main/master/head/dev/nightly/stable/current (also neueste/aktuell/последняя), wildcards, ranges (^ ~ > < || x *), versionRange.
Base model named but its version missing or floating.
Weights file without a hash (or with a value that is not a hex digest).
Pickle-based weights format (.pkl .pickle .pt .pth .bin .ckpt .joblib, or format pickle/pytorch/checkpoint/joblib): loading can execute code; safetensors is safer.
Weights hash uses MD5 or SHA-1.
Weights file without a source.
Own or fine-tuned model lists no weights files.
Fine-tuned model without a base model.
Dataset without a source.
Dataset personal-data status unknown or not stated.
Own or fine-tuned model lists no datasets.
Framework or library without a version.
Framework or library with a floating version.
External address uses http:// (localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are exempt).
Credentials in an address: user:password@ or a secret-named query parameter (key, token, secret, password, sig ...).
Value in a known secret format in any field (cloud, Git hosting, AI provider, Hugging Face, chat tokens, JWT, private key).
Unrecognized long random-looking value (32+ characters, letters and digits mixed, not a hex digest, not a URL).
No intended purpose.
No limitations.
No quality or safety evaluation.
No responsible person/team or no contact.
Model type (own, fine-tuned, external API) not stated.
Fine-tuned or external-API model without a vendor/supplier.
Review: no component of type machine-learning-model.
Review: structure problems in the checked subset (unknown or misspelled keys found only after key normalization, duplicate keys, wrong types, invalid enum/hash/serial values, dangling refs).

review_mapping: Review reads: model = components (also nested) with type machine-learning-model; name, version/versionRange, supplier.name (vendor), licenses (id, name or expression), pedigree.ancestors[0] (base model), property cyberdat:aibom:model-type, modelCard.considerations.useCases (purpose) and technicalLimitations (limitations), modelCard.quantitativeAnalysis.performanceMetrics or property cyberdat:aibom:safety-evaluation (evaluation). Weights = type file components (hashes, property cyberdat:aibom:weights-format, file extension of the name, externalReferences distribution url). Datasets = type data components (licenses, data[].contents.url or externalReferences, property cyberdat:aibom:personal-data or data[].sensitiveData non-empty = yes). Dependencies = type framework/library. External APIs = services[].endpoints. Responsible = metadata.supplier/manufacturer/authors, metadata.component supplier/manufacturer/authors, or model supplier/manufacturer/authors with a name and a contact (email or url). Keys are compared after normalization (case, _, -, camelCase).

error_codes.PARSE: Review input is not valid JSON (strict; line and column reported).
error_codes.NOT_CYCLONEDX: JSON is not a CycloneDX BOM object (bomFormat not CycloneDX).
